summary.text: Mike Argabright is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 17 (Lyon County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2025.

paragraphs.text: Mike Argabright is listed as a member of the Education Committee, the Financial Institutions and Insurance Committee, the Judiciary Committee and the Transportation Committee.
The page names Carla Argabright as Mike Argabright's spouse.
